name: Problem Radar
summary: Alert window for stuck vehicles, broken or money-losing lines, crowded stations and fleet health.
description: Collects stuck vehicles, broken or money-losing lines, crowded stations and fleet problems into one sortable window. Reads the game state only and is safe to add to an existing save.

ru.name: Problem Radar
ru.summary: Окно предупреждений: застрявший транспорт, сломанные или убыточные линии, переполненные остановки.

de.name: Problem Radar
de.summary: Meldefenster für feststeckende Fahrzeuge, defekte oder defizitäre Linien, volle Stationen, Fuhrpark.

nl.name: Problem Radar
